question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Web tools failed this run (API errors); evidence limited to provided news and harness market list. Q2 FY27 revenue $96.2B; Q3 guide $108B ±2%. Reference pattern: NVIDIA beats its guide by ~$3-6B, then guides next quarter ~11-13% above the actual, with guide-to-guide steps growing (+9, +11, +13B... per memory).
